title: Diego
text:
I’m a Software Engineer at the Critical Techworks. I am currently working with high scalable distributed systems (Java, Scala, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS).
Originally from Fortaleza (Brazil), I have a degree in Computer Science from the State University of Ceará (2010), and a Master’s in Computer Science from the Federal University of Ceará (2012).
In my free time, I love playing piano, dancing Forró, studying languages, and podcasting.
By the way, feel free to check out my podcast about languages, travel, and cultures: Diversilíngua 

To learn more about Quarto websites visit https://quarto.org/docs/websites.
